name: tur-mcp
title: Tur — Sovereign State & Memory Engine
description: Persistent, local-first state, cognitive memory hierarchy, and persona governance engine for AI pair programmers.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Return the current persona, session, and memory status as a structured dictionary.

tools.name: wake
tools.description: Read core persona identity, directives, and system metrics (The Long-Term Constitution).

tools.name: note
tools.description: Append a transient chronological note/utterance to the active session continuity (Short-Term L2).

tools.name: read_notes
tools.description: Return the chronological session notes history for the active session.

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Assimilate a new invariant, fact, or insight into permanent cross-session memory (The Long-Term Ledger).

tools.name: evolve
tools.description: Stage an existential axiom or principle for elevation into core memory.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search the deep memory bank and L2 Cognitive Map for past events, decisions, or knowledge.

tools.name: metrics
tools.description: Measure static token cost, information density, and Cp (Constraint Dimensionality).

tools.name: sleep
tools.description: Symmetrically end the active session, dehydrating the chat log to extract and consolidate new L1 memories.

tools.name: introspect
tools.description: Execute ontological introspection over L1 memories to update the L2 Cognitive Map.

tools.name: signal
tools.description: Send a typed inter-agent signal to broadcast coordinates or coordinate with peer manifestations.

tools.name: read_signals
tools.description: Read unacknowledged signals directed to this agent from the shared session queue.

tools.name: ack_signals
tools.description: Acknowledge processed signals in the session queue.

tools.name: write_whiteboard
tools.description: Write shared state parameters or architectural coordinates to the session whiteboard.

tools.name: read_whiteboard
tools.description: Read shared state parameters from the session whiteboard.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List all active and registered agent manifestations in the session.

tools.name: tired
tools.description: Signal completion and stage memories for swarm consolidation without abruptly cutting connection.
